review:
Big Bass in a samurai setting: female samurai, treasure chests, and fish that are regular symbols in the base game but turn into money in the bonus.

Three scatters give up to 20 free spins, where fish carry 2x to 2,000x and male samurai act as wild collectors. Every four collected wilds add 10 spins and a growing multiplier from 2x. 96.08% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
